answer: Each agent identity must lock a refundable bond in escrow before it can transact or attest. Creating one account is cheap, but a Sybil swarm needs one bond per fake identity, so a thousand puppets tie up a thousand bonds, capital that sits like basalt, immovable while those identities stay active. Proven fraud slashes the bond; honest agents recover theirs in full. A zephyr of fake signups thus meets a marble wall of locked cost, and attacking costs more than it can earn.
